feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: Pressure grows for Venezuela's authoritarian regime as opposition leader Machado returns
entry.summary: Maria Corina Machado's return to Venezuela presents a fresh challenge for Trump-backed President Delcy Rodríguez and reignites questions over the prospect of new elections.

entry.title: Milwaukee Brewers fans celebrate their team's first-ever World Series win
entry.summary: Wisconsin is enjoying its first Major League Baseball championship since the Milwaukee Braves took the title in 1957.

entry.title: Trump returns to South Carolina as Senate race tightens
entry.summary: President Trump returned to South Carolina - the second time in eight days. The amount of attention and money its U.S. Senate race is getting is raising questions about how red the state really is.

entry.title: Russia hosts African leaders at summit, as major powers compete for influence
entry.summary: As Russia hosts African leaders, it's making a pitch for influence, security partnerships and access to the continent's mineral wealth. But China and the U.S. are also vying for Africa's favor.

entry.title: U.S. Supreme Court faces consequential term on immigration law
entry.summary: Cases and controversies from President Trump's aggressive immigration are making their way to the Supreme Court this term, with several more disputes percolating on the emergency docket.

entry.title: Alaska's all-important Senate race is roiled by a report on alleged spoiler candidate
entry.summary: New reporting alleging Democratic efforts to prop up a spoiler candidate has roiled Alaska's all-important U.S. Senate race.

entry.title: A Brooklyn park inspired a spooky children's book about Halloween. But is it haunted?
entry.summary: Best-selling children's author R.J. Palacio talks about her new picture book called The Haunted Playground. It's about what ghosts get up to when they're off the clock.

entry.title: Ex-national security officials work with locals on worst-case scenarios for midterms
entry.summary: Retired military and national security leaders have been stepping up work to prepare local officials for possible worst-case scenarios like armed immigration officers or military at the polls.

entry.title: Candy prices got you scared stiff? What to know about the cost of Halloween this year
entry.summary: Candy companies are responding to increase in cocoa costs this year with creative combinations that use less chocolate. Despite higher prices for candy, consumers are still spending on Halloween.

entry.title: Another shake up at Pentagon as top general is ousted
entry.summary: Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth has ousted another top general from the Pentagon, further adding to a sense of discord amongst senior military leadership.
